chunks: worldly life is like the life of the world is like the rain that waters the crops of the earth which are used as food by men and cattle. But when the earth is embellished and adorned with gold, and its tillers begin to feel that (the crops) are under control, Our command descends suddenly at night or in the day, and We mow them down as though there was nothing there yesterday. This is how We distinctly explain Our signs to those who think.
ai.seo_question: 《优努斯章》中世俗生活的隐喻意义是什么？
ai.summary: 在什叶派经注中，这节经文常与‘祖赫德’（禁欲主义）的概念相联系，强调世俗繁荣只是暂时的考验而非永恒的状态。从极致美丽到荒凉的突然转变提醒人们真主的全能以及后世的必然性，促使信徒摆脱物质的幻象。
